studies.title: Reversal follow-through
studies.summary: The retained historical comparison does not establish a clear ES or NQ chart winner. Requested GC 20 evidence is missing; chart identity and timing remain provisional.
studies.evidenceStatus: Imported historical results; unreviewed during consolidation.

studies.title: Follow-through candle adverse movement
studies.summary: Saved candle geometry estimates condition on eventual same-direction closes. Corrected complete-leg duration is a raw clock proxy; neither result is a live entry filter.
studies.evidenceStatus: Imported historical results; unreviewed during consolidation.

studies.title: Multi-Range-XV alignment
studies.summary: Strictly prior larger-chart alignment improves next-bar colour continuation most consistently in ES and GC. Longer runs are less stable; shared price streams limit independence.
studies.evidenceStatus: Imported historical results; unreviewed during consolidation.

studies.title: Reversal candle quality
studies.summary: Aligned strong candles show a next-bar colour advantage that weakens over longer runs. Saved mean next-bar returns remain negative before costs, despite high continuation rates.
studies.evidenceStatus: Imported historical results; unreviewed during consolidation.

studies.title: Session-anchored VWAP
studies.summary: ES, NQ and GC price-path evidence shows frequent return by window end, while extreme fades and first retest bounces do not demonstrate stable incremental advantage. These observations do not establish net profitability.
studies.evidenceStatus: Price-path statistics from the pinned 1.0.0 release; execution costs and fills remain unmodeled. A/C context cuts are exploratory and re-entry lacks a paired policy comparison.

studies.title: VWAP state dynamics
studies.summary: Persistent states retain more future residence, while opposing slopes predict more crossing. Coarse matching shrinks both gaps; local-anchor checks reverse the pooled VWAP–TWAP conclusion.
studies.evidenceStatus: Three frozen probability questions evaluated; all available dates exploratory because prior VWAP outcomes were viewed. No execution or profitability model.

studies.title: Range XV edge candidates
studies.summary: Three ES/NQ/GC chart-price candidates fail the frozen cost and familywise screen. Retrospectively inspected dates and unverified completion/fill timing limit trading claims.
studies.evidenceStatus: Three chart-price candidates evaluated; none passes the declared two-tick and familywise screen. All dates retrospectively inspected.

studies.title: Range XV first countertrend bar continuation
studies.summary: Across seven ES/GC/NQ Range XV settings, the frozen two-more-bar screen finds no supported positive lift above its chart/direction/window baseline. Chart colour continuation is descriptive, not a payoff test.
studies.evidenceStatus: Locally verified descriptive bar-behavior evidence; inferred completion and unmodeled execution prevent a trading-edge claim.

relatedPublications.label: Earlier presentation; superseded because its baseline wording was incorrect. Use the featured corrected publication.

studies.title: Range XV C2 confirmation decision
studies.summary: Some confirmed cohorts beat ordinary two-bar baselines, but waiting does not improve signed chart-price means. Confirmed samples and original opportunities have different denominators.
studies.evidenceStatus: Locally verified descriptive bar-behavior evidence; inferred completion and unmodeled execution prevent a trading-edge claim.

studies.title: Range XV Asia, London, and New York session overlay
studies.summary: Asia, London and New York overlays preserve negative price screens. Selected NQ colour contrasts vary by session, while the confirmation wait policy remains negative.
studies.evidenceStatus: locally verified exploratory overlay

relatedPublications.label: Earlier presentation; superseded because its baseline wording was incorrect. Use the featured corrected publication.

studies.title: VWAP conditional probabilities
studies.summary: Conditional checkpoint and destination probabilities describe mature VWAP episodes. Geometry adds only small context-model improvements; these are exploratory associations, not trading probabilities.
studies.evidenceStatus: Locally verified exploratory conditional-probability evidence; no pristine holdout and no profitability claim.

studies.title: GC outer lower EMA band excursions
studies.summary: Next-open GC excursions after a close below the outer lower EMA band vary by year. The saved default grid is descriptive; excursion extrema are not executable exits.
studies.evidenceStatus: locally verified descriptive evidence

relatedPublications.label: Earlier annual presentation; the featured revision corrects the interval-method wording.

studies.title: GC lower-band long: two-year filter selection
studies.summary: An upper-half signal close was selected in 2025. Its chronological 2026 improvement remains uncertain, and the filtered score is negative; this is conditional path evidence.
studies.evidenceStatus: locally verified descriptive evidence; improvement uncertain

studies.title: Asia session VP levels study
studies.summary: The original A–C protocol studies POC reversal, value-boundary retest and pre-touch HVN fade on NQ. Matched-control evidence is mixed; later D/E extensions are excluded.
studies.evidenceStatus: Verified local descriptive A–C evidence under original protocol 1.0.0. The later D/E extension is exploratory and excluded from this selected publication. No executable edge or strategy promotion.

studies.title: Anchored VWAP excursion and return study
studies.summary: Fresh two-sigma departures show different return and response behavior by anchor and product. Complete-path denominators and shared-week uncertainty limit these to exploratory price evidence.
studies.evidenceStatus: Locally verified descriptive excursion and first-touch evidence on retrospectively complete, previously viewed history. No profitability claim; native Pine compilation remains unverified.

relatedPublications.label: Earlier twenty-minute presentation; the featured revision corrects the signed-delta label.

studies.title: Range XV reversals: follow-through and predictive lead-up
studies.summary: Eight FX chart/direction populations retain separate continuation rates. Adding prior-leg length or richer history yields no supported primary log-loss improvement beyond reversal geometry and context.
studies.evidenceStatus: Protocol 2.0.0 sealed locally with complete event/prediction evidence, numerical/source/bootstrap/report verification, and negative/inconclusive results. No executable trading edge is established.

relatedPublications.label: Earlier concise presentation of the same saved reversal evidence.

studies.title: NQ advanced AMD video source study
studies.summary: A qualitative review of Tmac's weekly-to-intraday decision process, with selected charts showing confirmation, a no-trade day, reassessment and an unmet target. One reviewed week does not establish independently verified performance or profitability.
studies.evidenceStatus: Qualitative source review only. No independent trade verification or profitability test. Quarterly-candle regularity is unverified; the all-time-high objective was not reached in the lesson's reviewed week.

relatedPublications.label: Earlier qualitative pilot; the featured revision adds attributed source links.

studies.title: Value-area fade: external trade tracker
studies.summary: Christopher Thornton’s 55- and 100-trade snapshots, a proposed first-touch VAH/VAL-to-POC fade, seven source charts and a plan for future independent Abacus analysis.
studies.evidenceStatus: External source review only; reported aggregates are unaudited. The cumulative snapshots overlap. Independent analysis remains planned, with no Abacus backtest or verified net profitability.

studies.title: Camarilla reversals and the EMA20/50 cloud
studies.summary: Historical ES/NQ/GC five-minute rejection paths and a separate assumed-cost 3R policy. No positive alignment improvement is supported by the six primary final-evaluation contrasts; sparse support and mapping/calendar qualifications limit interpretation.
studies.evidenceStatus: Verified historical descriptive evidence and assumed-fill simulation. All final R3/S3 alignment cohorts are sparse; policy intervals include zero. Mapping arrival and annual holiday certification remain unavailable.
